# Serialized string fields that are NOT paths.
#
# Every toml- or json-tagged field whose type bottoms out in a string, in every
# package the shared load matched, is filed exactly once: in
# pathfence.Fields() if it holds a path, or here if it does not
# (TestEveryPathShapedFieldIsDeclared, pathfence_fields_test.go).
#
# One field per line: <pkg>.<Type>.<Field> <tag>. There is no -update flag —
# filing a field is a judgement. A new field fails the suite with the exact row
# to paste; paste it only if the value is not a path.
#
# Filing here is not a free pass. The path-field taint scan
# (pathtaint_audit_test.go) traces every row: a value filed here that reaches a
# filesystem call is a finding, fixed by declaring the field a path and routing
# it through pathfence.Contain — never by leaving it here.
